verdicts.reason: A: the phone illustration is scaled up until it runs into the top and bottom canvas edges and gets cut off at the bottom, with almost all of its cream circle hidden. There is also a big gap between the headline and the subline, so the copy block falls apart, though the right-hand ONLINE ONLY badge and CTA group still holds. B has the same headline/subline gap, plus the phone is shrunk and floats above its cream circle instead of sitting on it, and the circle is cropped at the bottom edge, so the brand graphic looks broken and the left column is lopsided.
